title: From Single to Societal: Analyzing Persona-Induced Bias in Multi-Agent Interactions
reasoning: The paper focuses on demographic biases (gender and race) and their impact on social interaction behaviors such as trustworthiness, insistence, and conformity within multi-agent systems. While it examines persuasion regarding ethical or social issues as a task, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
